title: Grayy
description: A gray themed texture pack designed for Vanilla PvP. Very low effort like always!
body:
This Vanilla PvP texture pack has everything you need to become a pro!

This texture pack features essential changes like low fire and a small totem pop. It also has a gray theme present throughout the pack. This is recommended to be used alongside another pack as an overlay. 

This pack took just about 2-3 days of work to finish, it's a pretty lightweight one.
